jwt_signing_key.description: Signing key for hosted GUI session JWTs; auto-generated by the runner if omitted

oauth_google_client_secret.description: OAuth client secret from Google Cloud Console, required when Google sign-in is enabled

oauth_microsoft_client_secret.description: OAuth client secret from Azure App Registration, required when Microsoft sign-in is enabled

oauth_github_client_secret.description: OAuth client secret from a GitHub OAuth App, required when GitHub sign-in is enabled
